required_checks: Freeze all owned Lean/config sources and exact capstone names only once development is complete.
Fresh private source build with warnings as errors; direct strict replay of every owned source, including any nondefault auxiliary modules and Lake configuration.
Pin dependency sources to Git objects and map imported cached modules; record runtime/import identity and stability.
Audit all owned declaration roots and transitive type/body/inductive/recursor dependencies; only standard propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound axioms allowed.
Run verifier positive and rejected axiom/sorry/native/unsafe controls as part of the full run; classify any generated unsafe helpers explicitly.
Independent semantic review of actual Euclidean factors, true projective/nuclear norm, nonzero tensor, official extreme points, relative nondensity and honest scope interpretation.
Run every included auxiliary computation if any is needed; no numerical experiment substitutes for the universal proof.
Match final report to checked sources; native LaTeX compile, matching PDF generation and full visual inspection.
Fresh publication eligibility and exact committed personal-folder scope before own-fork push and upstream PR.
limits: No proof, report, package, or publication has passed final validation yet.
Cached Mathlib imports are pinned; this workflow does not rebuild all Mathlib or bootstrap Lean.
A dependency-graph audit is not an independent proof kernel; source compilation provides kernel checks.
Generic verifier controls already have an independent tool review; no redundant pre-run of unchanged tool tests planned.
